messages:
jules: Quick design sync about two small but noisy bits on the credentials list: (1) a visibility toggle "Show secret" affordance and (2) a "recently revoked" shelf (soft-delete) with a 7-day undo. Mock: https://staging.redwood.local/ui/creds-visibility-revoke-2199997777.png

maria: Nice. For visibility, I prefer an inline affordance that reads 'Reveal secret' vs just an eye icon. Better for discoverability, especially for non-power users. Maybe make it a secondary action to avoid accidental reveals.

lee: From an engineering POV: adding per-row reveal requests should be rate-limited and audited. We'll need an endpoint that returns a one-time token for the secret and a short TTL (10s). Also confirm that reveal actions are logged with actor and IP.

ada: Accessibility: the reveal control must have a descriptive aria-label (e.g., "Reveal API key for integration X"). When the secret is shown, the field should be in a role="region" with aria-live="polite" so screen readers announce content changes. Also ensure the secret text is selectable by keyboard-only users.

sam: About the recently revoked shelf: I propose a collapsible area at the top of the list labeled "Recently revoked (7 days)" with each row showing "Undo" and "Permanently delete". Undo should be the primary affordance and undoable inline (no modal).

maria: Copy suggestion for the shelf header: "Recently revoked 4 can be restored for 7 days". For the undo button label, prefer "Restore" over "Undo" (clearer for some users).

lee: Backend notes: restoring a key should re-enable its token idempotently. We'll return 409 if the key name collides with a new key; in that case UI should prompt the user to rename the restored key. Also provide an audit link per row to view revoke time and actor.

ada: A11y for the shelf: make it keyboard-collapsible (Enter/Space) and expose aria-expanded on the header. When the shelf auto-dismisses (7-day expiry) announce via an aria-live polite region: "Recently revoked shelf updated: key 'x' expired and removed." Avoid noisy announcements.

jules: Microcopy choices for reveal CTA: A) "Reveal key" B) "Show secret" C) icon-only with tooltip. I lean A for clarity. Thoughts?

maria: A is best. Also add a small helper under the reveal: "This value is shown once. It is stored encrypted and view actions are audited." That should reduce support questions.

lee: UI detail: when revealing, mask other sensitive fields on the page to avoid shoulder-surfing. Also blur the secret after 10s automatically and put keyboard focus back on the reveal button.

ada: Make sure the auto-blur is configurable and announced: "Secret will be hidden in 10 seconds" via aria-live. If the user navigates away before 10s, cancel the blur timer.

sam: Action items: (1) @jules update mock with 'Reveal key' wording and shelf header copy. (2) @lee document reveal token TTL, audit events, and restore failure cases. (3) @ada add a11y checklist for aria-labels, region announcements, focus return, and shelf auto-dismiss announces. (4) @maria draft the helper copy and small in-product tooltip.
